Add a persisted/unsaved distinction (or an explicit assumption that the life is the in-memory table) with a transition for Main.vb:618 / CmtxFile.vb:122; note the Try/Catch at Main.vb:617-621 swallows write failures so a comment can silently stay unsaved, and that deleting a comment reaches the file only at that save.
